acceptance_predicates.description: Selected and explicit all-workload recording requests resolve through the authoritative bounded catalog.
The all-workloads sentinel passes client and server admission, expands to a non-empty bounded matrix, and binds the response.
Invalid, empty, duplicate, and oversized selections fail closed without partially activating a campaign.
A sealed cassette can be activated for offline replay with egress denied and digest-bound comparison.
Missing authentication, signatures, and key management remain visible development-only warnings and never block the prototype.

definition_of_done: Merged exact-main implementation passes focused recording, endpoint, and full hosted checks.
Independent review verifies the real wire admission path and bounded all-workloads behavior.
Post-merge receipt records exact protected-main head and exact-main checks.

inputs.description: Versioned recording campaign request, response binding, sealing, and offline replay protocol.

outputs.description: Selected/all workload recording campaign controls with bounded execution and sealed offline replay activation.

gates.description: All required PR and exact-main checks pass on the merged head.
